Short impact summary

Full narrative

Particle Accelerator Physics by Helmut Wiedemann was published by Springer Nature in 2015. It is part of the Graduate texts in physics series. Conceptually, the work connects to Particle accelerator, Physics, Nuclear physics, Particle (ecology) and Geology.

OpenAlex records 350 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2021 with 48 citing works. Notable citing venues include Physical Review Accelerators and Beams, Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research Section A Accelerators Spectrometers Detectors and Associated Equipment and Physical Review Special Topics - Accelerators and Beams. Of 270 citation statements scite has classified, 3 support its claims, 263 mention it in passing, and none contradict it. The citing works include 257 journal articles, 32 book chapters and 12 reports. They come from 40 countries, led by the United States, Germany and China.

It has been downloaded 18,381 times via OAPEN. Its subject matter aligns with Affordable and clean energy among the Sustainable Development Goals.
